_comment: Proposed meaningful strategic regions for the ~460-province 'full Europe' grand theater (Vic3/HOI4-style macro zones). Replace/seed the generic ones in strategic_regions.json during next merge or curation pass. Averages ~20-30 provinces per region for good operational scale.

regions.name: Southern England
regions.notes: London, Home Counties, south coast.

regions.name: Northern England & Midlands
regions.notes: Industrial north, Midlands corridor.

regions.name: Scotland
regions.notes: Highlands, Central Belt, Orkney approaches.

regions.name: Wales
regions.notes: Cardiff, Welsh valleys, western Britain.

regions.name: Ireland
regions.notes: Republic + Northern Ireland; provinces stay separate.

regions.name: Low Countries
regions.notes: Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg. Dense, high infra, chokepoints.

regions.name: Western Germany
regions.notes: Rhineland, Ruhr, Saar. Industrial heartland + French border.

regions.name: Central Germany
regions.notes: Berlin approaches, Saxony, Bohemia edge.

regions.name: Scandinavia
regions.notes: Norway (fjords), Sweden, Denmark. Lengthy coast, iron ore, northern flank.

regions.name: Baltic Littoral
regions.notes: Baltic states, East Prussia, Polish coast, Danish Straits approaches.

regions.name: Poland & Silesia
regions.notes: Core Poland, Silesia, Krakow. Eastern Front gateway.

regions.name: Western Russia
regions.notes: Karelia, Kola, Leningrad approaches, White Sea. High north + Murmansk.

regions.name: Alpine & North Italy
regions.notes: Switzerland, Austrian Alps, Po valley, Venice.

regions.name: France & Champagne
regions.notes: Metropolitan France north/center, Maginot area.

regions.name: Iberia
regions.notes: Spain + Portugal. Iberian peninsula, Gibraltar approaches.

regions.name: Western Mediterranean
regions.notes: Southern France, Italy west, Corsica, Sardinia, Balearics.

regions.name: Balkans
regions.notes: Yugoslavia area, Romania, Bulgaria. Mountainous, multiple fronts.

regions.name: Greece & Aegean
regions.notes: Greece, Crete, Aegean islands. Naval + island hopping.

regions.name: Anatolia & Straits
regions.notes: Turkey, Bosporus/Dardanelles, Black Sea exit. Critical chokepoint.

regions.name: North Africa Coast
regions.notes: Tunisia, Algeria, Libya extension of theater. Desert + ports.

regions.name: Carpathians & Ukraine Border
regions.notes: Hungary, Slovakia, western Ukraine approaches.

regions.name: Central Russia Edge
regions.notes: Further east of Leningrad/Moscow approaches for depth.

regions.name: Atlantic Approaches
regions.notes: Faroes, Iceland edge, Bay of Biscay, convoy routes (sea + air).

regions.name: Arctic & Barents
regions.notes: High arctic islands, Murmansk convoys, northern sea route.
